greeting.text: Winners, questions, trouble. One of those.

redeem.text: Winners cash at the tray. Dead paper stays that way.

loose.text: Maybe. Maybe the ceiling heard you ask.

routes.text: Gas station paper turns jumpy after midnight.

counter.text: Late shelf. Cheap if you don't linger.
People talk when the cooler hums loud enough.

notice.text: The room's done pretending it loves you. Door's there.

line.text: Keep the slips flat, sugar. The Cage remembers clean hands.
Rourke watches shortcuts. I watch who doesn't need one.
The rope opens for a record, honey. Not a story.

answer.text: You found the one phone in town that still bills guilt by the minute. You all right?

weather.text: Nobody checks in from a counter phone after dark. How deep is it?

apartment_intro.text: I'm your pal. Build cash and earn a Players Card. $0 or full Heat ends the run. Watch Heat, Drunk, and time. Take the glasses.

inventory_check.text: Open Inventory. Permanent passives work while carried; consumables are spent. Only one active item can be equipped. Confirm the X-ray Glasses and read their effect.

map_corner.text: Travel spends time and may cost cash; open hours matter. Buy gear, gamble, manage Debt, and earn Bronze toward Gold. Open the map; the corner store is your only stop.

map_destination.text: The map shows travel cost, minutes, and open state. Corner Store costs $0 now. Select it, then Travel.

corner_items.text: We're buying both shelf items, but inspect them first. Each card shows its price and your Bankroll after purchase. Start with the Instant Coffee.

corner_pencil.text: Good. Now inspect the Ledger Pencil so you know what both items do before spending anything.

corner_buy_both.text: Buy both the Instant Coffee and the Ledger Pencil. Either order is fine; after the first purchase, I'll point you to the one that's left.

corner_buy_remaining.text: One shelf item is still waiting. Buy the other one too, then we'll move on.

crew_warning.text: That Crew cash isn't free. Take it, and sooner or later they'll put you to work for it.

family_phone.text: Use the counter phone and take the $30 family loan. It raises Bankroll now, adds family Debt to the HUD, and future cashout pays Debt first.

family_debt.text: The receipt icon is family Debt. Bankroll rose by $30, but cashout pays Debt first. Keep enough cash to survive the run.

parking_tip.text: Open the parking-lot note and choose Follow the tip. It may lead somewhere useful later.

route_split.text: That tip opened two doors. I strongly recommend the Gas Casino lesson, but it's optional: choose Gas Casino, or skip it and go straight Underground.

gas_machine.text: Open the pull-tab machine. Outcomes are fixed when each ticket is bought; peeling only reveals them. Your glasses mark a real winner in the stack.

gas_peek.text: Without a Tab Detector, this says PEEK. Each try has a 50% chance to highlight the nearest winner, but always adds Heat: 8%, then 9%, 10%, and 11%. Peek four times and watch the meter.

gas_peek_again_3.text: That was one Peek. Keep going: 3 attempts remain. A miss is normal; the next try still has its own 50% chance and adds more Heat.

gas_peek_again_2.text: Two Peeks down; 2 remain. Try again and watch the Heat cost climb whether the highlight appears or not.

gas_peek_again_1.text: Only 1 Peek remains. Watch the machine, then compare this fourth Heat increase with the first.

gas_peek_heat.text: Even a failed Peek adds real Heat. Repeated cheats get harder to hide. A Tab Detector changes PEEK to SCAN, reliably toggles the highlight, and adds no Heat.

gas_xray.text: Read the yellow marker: it shows tickets left and total cost. Buy that column, then Collect each dropped ticket until the marked winner is purchased.

gas_peel.text: Select the marked ticket and Peel all three windows. When the result is showing, click the completed ticket itself to file it into the winner pile. Leave only after the winner is filed.

gas_clerk.text: Leave the machine, open Rina's clerk tray, and Redeem. A filed winner isn't cash until the clerk pays it.

gas_depart.text: Open the map and head underground. The gas stop was optional.

underground_enter.text: At blackjack, get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. 2-10 use their number, face cards are 10, and an Ace is 1 or 11. Sit for a clean hand.

blackjack_normal.text: First hand, keep it simple. Set your wager on the felt and Deal. Hit asks for another card; Stand keeps what you have and lets the dealer finish.

blackjack_finish.text: You have the idea. Play this hand out at your pace—Hit if you want another card, or Stand when you are ready to compare with the dealer.

blackjack_raise.text: Good. For the second hand, raise the wager once. I want enough on the felt that the next lesson feels like a real decision.

blackjack_deal_raised.text: Now Deal. This whole second hand is about learning Peek, so we will leave counting alone until the next one.

heat_before_cheat.text: See the Heat meter up top? That is how much attention you have drawn. Fill it and the run is over, so every cheat needs to earn its risk.

blackjack_lookaway.text: The easiest cheat starts with a real lookaway. DRINK PASS spills a drink; CHIP SPILL is your backup. Make the opening first, then Peek.

blackjack_peek.text: There is your opening. Peek now and you will see the hole card before choosing Hit or Stand. Get caught and it can add heat or close the table.

blackjack_peek_finish.text: Now use what you saw. Finish this Peek hand before we move on—Hit if you need another card, or Stand when you are ready for the dealer.

blackjack_count_start.text: One more hand, and this one is only for counting. Turn Count on, then Deal. In Hi-Lo, 2-6 is +1, 7-9 is 0, and 10 through Ace is -1.

blackjack_count_bubbles.text: Now follow the cards and select each bubble before it fades. Miss one and you gain Heat; clear the full hand and you avoid that penalty.

blackjack_count_finish.text: Good. Keep watching for a new count marker if you Hit, then play this third hand out with Hit or Stand. The lesson is not finished until the hand settles.

heat.text: That real mistake raised Heat. Full Heat ends the run and high Heat makes risky play harsher. Stop cheating, play clean, or travel to cool off before trying again.

heat_99.text: You really need to calm down. I pulled your Heat back to 75% so the lesson can continue, but I can't keep doing your breathing for you.

drunk_coffee.text: Easy. You crossed 33% Drunk. Take this Thermos of Black Coffee. Open Inventory, equip it as your active item, then press Use Item to lower Drunk and steady the room.

drunk_coffee_repeat.text: You're over 33% Drunk again. Calm down. I've made sure you have another Thermos of Black Coffee; equip it from Inventory and use the active-item button whenever you want the room steady.

drunk_coffee_used.text: There you go. The coffee lowered Drunk and steadied the distortion. Other active items work the same way: equip one from Inventory, then use it from the active-item slot when its effect matters.

invitation.text: Before you leave, keep an eye on your environment. Open the Grand Casino invitation and accept it.

drink_intro.text: The bar sells courage with a timer on it. A drink can lift Luck, but Drunk slows the room, bends timing, and makes Heat harder to read. Buying is optional. Knowing the trade isn't.

grand_depart.text: I'm banned from the Grand. Play clean around Rourke. Good luck.

meta_home_card.text: This is Home. Your new Bronze Players Card is already packed in the highlighted Bag. Open it to inspect the card. Packed collection items enter your next run; if a carried Players Card is destroyed on a loss, it is gone for good.

tip06_tonight_changes_rooms.text: Tonight's scenario changes this room. Read the objective and listen before acting; a rumor here can sharpen another map stop.

tip06_delivery_route.text: That package is contraband and every action spends its deadline. Use the map to choose among the marked real stops.

tip06_numbers_book.text: Pick three digits and a stake before the daily draw. Town talk can guide the numbers, but carrying the slip is contraband.

tip06_crew_standing.text: Crew jobs build standing and missed work is remembered. That standing opens rooms; it is a path, not another loan.

tip06_coin_pusher.text: Drag the carriage to aim, then hold and release DROP. Bonus-token cups extend play; bank the heavy feature pieces to finish this cabinet's goal.

tip06_craps_pass_line.text: Put one stake on Pass. Seven or eleven wins the come-out; otherwise make the point before a seven.

tip06_venue_depth.text: Some venues have more room behind them. Watch the room itself for a way through; a usable door appears when the time is right.

speaker.name: Dealer
speaker.behavior: keeping one hand on the shoe

warning.text: Just this once I'll leave it open, but don't let me catch you again.

grand_entry.text: Welcome. I'm Vivienne Vale. Table play earns Players Card standing.

comp.text: Take the free suite comp before visiting the Cage. Comps are stored on your Players Card for their stated use; this one costs nothing.

cage.text: Linda sees to accounts, chips, and cashout at the Cage.

shop.text: Those goods are stocked on the shelves like any other shop. Pick an item to read its details; the price comes from your chips, not your cash. Buying is optional.

return_main_floor.text: Your chips are ready. Head back to the Main Floor; I will point out the blackjack table there.

table_play.text: That highlighted table is blackjack. Finish two hands with chips—wins or losses both count. Bronze becomes ready only after the second hand settles.

return_linda.text: Bronze is ready. Linda will hand it over at the Cage.

buy_chips_reminder.text: You still need chips for the lesson. Go back to Linda and buy a chip bundle before you leave the Cage.

claim_card_reminder.text: Bronze is ready. Go back to Linda and claim your Players Card before you leave the Cage.

collect_card_reminder.text: Don't leave your Players Card on Linda's counter. Go back, talk to her again, and choose Collect Players Card before you leave the Cage.

speaker.name: Rourke
speaker.behavior: watching from the edge of the floor

intro.text: Play clean on my floor and you've nothing to fear.

speaker.name: Vivienne Vale
speaker.behavior: meeting a new arrival beneath the chandelier

greeting.text: Welcome to the Grand. I'm Vivienne, your host. The floor is yours.

speaker.name: Linda
speaker.behavior: sliding a Bronze card beneath the barred glass

goal.text: Bronze Players Card, sugar. You learned items, travel, debt, pull-tabs, blackjack, cheating, Heat, chips, comps, and card progress. Gold is the next tier.

persistence.text: Your collection and Players Card rewards persist between runs; ordinary run cash, chips, debt, and carried gear don't unless a reward says otherwise. Normal runs are now open.

next_goal.text: Start a normal run, build Bankroll without filling Heat, improve your collection, and return to Linda after enough Grand Casino table play to earn the Gold Players Card.

choices.label: Take the Card Home
choices.text: Finish the guided run and enter Home with the new Players Card.

demo_finale.message: Linda issues Bronze and leaves the Gold Players Card as your next goal.

choices.label: Walk Away for Now
choices.text: Leave the card with Linda and return for it later.

restock.text: I keep the clerk's schedule. This machine resets every three hours; I'll give you the exact times.

denial.text: Restock time? Never heard of it. I just like standing here.
